main_body: A side-profile chair (facing east/west): a tall backrest column on the left and a seat that projects right, with legs below. Seat reads only as a thin edge band.
top_band: Seat top is a thin ~2px tan strip (rows ~9-10) on the profile; the backrest top is a 1-2px cap. No wide horizontal surface seen from above.
evidence: The chair is an L-shaped side profile like the guide's red 'side elevation chair'. The seat surface is only a 1-2px edge and does not read as a horizontal surface seen from above. The backrest is a vertical bar with no visible top. Legs are dark, thin strips. There is no 3/4 seat band with a front edge and an eave.

style.evidence: The chair has about 3-4 wood tones (tan, orange, brown, dark brown) with a dark brown outline that is tinted to the material. It has no grain or texture dots, and the backrest and seat are mostly flat fills. It is a tiny piece with far fewer colours per tile than the stall and well references, which carry textured tiles, highlights and many tones. It would look thinner and flatter next to them.
